senses.gloss: f. (בָּרַח) a woman making an assignment before marrying in order to exclude her husband from the right of inheritance.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 79a:2">Keth. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>שטר מ׳</he> the document of assignment.
B. Bath. 150ᵇ מ׳ צריכה וכ׳ a mabraḥath must assign all her belongings.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 151a:6">Ib. 151ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ קני</he> (sub. <he>שטר</he>) an assignment of a woman &c. gives possession to the assignee (although it is merely formal); a. e.
